explanation: The vulnerable/fixed pair for list_api_keys adds an authorization dependency (RequirePermissionIfAuthEnabled) but does not involve a hard-coded cryptographic key. The real CWE-321 issue is the hard-coded JWT secret in backend/app/core/auth.py, which is not shown or corrected here. This pair is an access-control/missing-authorization defect, not cryptographic misuse under the target taxonomy.
finding: [CRYPTO-007] Hard-coded cryptographic key found inline. Keys must be loaded from secrets management, env vars, or a KDF. (CWE-321) at backend/app/api/routes/api_keys.py.
